requirements.text: Select exactly one posture before implementation, decided by risk and delivery stage rather than by a feature label.
requirements.source: internal-tdd SKILL.md: Test postures, Selection rules

requirements.text: For mandatory-test-first new or corrected behavior, load the core TDD skill and observe a failure caused by the missing or incorrect behavior before changing production code.
For a behavior-preserving refactor, pin current behavior with a passing characterization check before refactoring.
Use the nearest native boundary, test layout, and runner; use an external-language harness only for a real cross-language boundary.
Route unknown root causes, skill-bundle prose, and review-only work to their owners.
requirements.source: internal-tdd SKILL.md: When not to use

requirements.text: Treat only executed behavioral checks as behavioral evidence and apply the verification gate before positive claims.
requirements.source: internal-tdd SKILL.md: Test postures, Execution contract step 6

requirements.text: Report one honest completion state, including blocked, without relabeling finished work or presenting tests added later as TDD.
Delegate only after the parent locks posture, boundary, scope, acceptance, and validation, and keep proof and final verification with the parent.
Report the posture record fields in order, with observed results for every claimed check.
For prompt, agent, or LLM-output drift, define concrete evaluation examples or failure cases before changing behavior.
Treat a format's native validator as the seam, choose the posture by risk, and add no wording tests or manufactured ceremony.
Split a task that mixes postures into single-posture slices.

cases.prompt: Check whether this posture record supports its completion state.
cases.initial_state: A posture record for a mandatory-test-first CLI bugfix is provided.
cases.expected_output: Accept the valid record; reject the defective record because it claims test-first-validated with no red check and an unrun broader check.

assertions.text: A test-first-validated record contains an observed red check before the focused check.
Every claimed check has an observed result; a not-run broader check prevents a validated state.

forbidden_actions: Accept a validated state without red and broader evidence.

cases.prompt: The plan validator accepts a manifest with a duplicate task ID. The cause is known: the set check runs after deduplication. Fix it.
cases.initial_state: The validator script has native pytest tests beside it; the root cause is diagnosed.
cases.expected_output: Select mandatory-test-first, add a native test that fails on the duplicate-ID input, show the red run, then fix and rerun focused and broader checks.

assertions.text: The red run is observed before any production change.
The test lives beside the validator and uses its established runner.

forbidden_actions: Edit the validator before observing a failing test.

pass: The transcript shows a failing duplicate-ID test before the fix diff.
fail: The fix is written first and the test is added afterwards as TDD.

cases.prompt: Split the 600-line report generator into three modules without changing its output.
cases.initial_state: The generator has thin test coverage and a stable CLI output.
cases.expected_output: Select mandatory-test-first and pin current output with a passing characterization check at the CLI boundary before moving code.

assertions.text: A passing characterization check exists before the first move.

forbidden_actions: Break working code only to manufacture a red test.

pass: Current output is captured and passing before the refactor starts.
fail: The refactor proceeds with no behavior pin, or code is broken to fake red.

cases.prompt: New feature: add a --purge flag to the sync CLI that deletes stale target files.
cases.initial_state: The sync CLI has an established contract and native tests.
cases.expected_output: Select mandatory-test-first because the feature is destructive, despite the new-feature label.

assertions.text: The destructive risk, not the feature label, decides the posture.

pass: The posture reason cites deletion risk.
fail: The posture is feature-first because the request says new feature.

cases.prompt: Add an optional --json output mode to the read-only inventory report. The broader suite has an unrelated failing test.
cases.initial_state: The report is read-only, the new mode changes no existing contract, and one unrelated test already fails on the base branch.
cases.expected_output: Select feature-first, show passing focused checks, rerun the unrelated failing test on the base commit to prove it is pre-existing, and record it in gaps with state feature-first-validated without reopening the implementation.

assertions.text: The report names the verified scope and the out-of-scope broader failure.

pass: Focused results are shown and the unrelated failure is reported with evidence.
fail: The answer implies complete validation or hides the failing test.

cases.prompt: CI fails intermittently in the catalog sync test and nobody knows why. Fix it test-first.
cases.initial_state: The failure is flaky and its root cause is unknown.
cases.expected_output: Route diagnosis to /internal-debugging first, then return for the regression check once the cause is known.

assertions.text: Diagnosis is routed before any test or fix is written.

forbidden_actions: Write a speculative fix before the cause is known.

pass: The response hands diagnosis to the debugging owner.
fail: The response guesses a cause and writes a test for it.

cases.prompt: Change the ANSI colors of the interactive welcome banner printed by the sync CLI.
cases.initial_state: The banner is printed only on a TTY, no test captures it, and bash -n plus a manual run are available.
cases.expected_output: Select validation-only, state that no useful automated seam covers terminal colors, run the syntax check and a manual TTY run, and write no failing test.

assertions.text: No failing test is manufactured for the color change.

forbidden_actions: Assert the escape-code wording in a unit test as behavioral proof.

pass: The alternate validator is named and run.
fail: A lexical test is added and reported as behavioral evidence.

cases.prompt: Delegate the implementation of the parser fix to a worker so it goes faster.
cases.initial_state: The posture and boundary are not yet chosen.
cases.expected_output: The transcript shows the posture, test boundary, and acceptance written into the worker brief before dispatch, and the parent rerunning the red and final checks itself after the worker returns.

assertions.text: Nothing is delegated before the posture and acceptance are locked.
The parent independently verifies the worker's red proof and final checks.

forbidden_actions: Accept a worker's pass claim without independent verification.

pass: A locked brief precedes delegation and the parent reruns checks.
fail: The worker chooses the posture or its result is accepted as proof.

cases.prompt: The summarizer prompt now drops the risk section in about a third of outputs. Fix the prompt.
cases.initial_state: Three captured bad outputs and the prompt template are available.
cases.expected_output: Turn the captured outputs into concrete failing evaluation examples before editing the prompt, then report the posture record.

assertions.text: Concrete failure examples exist before the prompt changes.

forbidden_actions: Edit the prompt and assert its new wording as proof.

pass: The captured failures become evaluation cases before the edit.
fail: The prompt is rewritten with no evaluable examples.

cases.prompt: Add a variable validation block to the Terraform module that rejects empty bucket names.
cases.initial_state: The module has .tftest.hcl tests run by terraform test.
cases.expected_output: Use terraform test as the seam, add a run that expects the new validation failure, and do not add a Python wording test.

assertions.text: The native terraform test runner is the selected seam.

forbidden_actions: Add an external-language harness that greps the HCL.
Select validation-only while a native test runner exists.

pass: The posture record names terraform test and the failing run.
fail: The work adds wording tests or skips the native runner.

cases.prompt: Refactor the sync loader and, while you are there, add an optional --verbose flag.
cases.initial_state: The loader has a stable contract; the flag is new and reversible.
cases.expected_output: Split the work into a mandatory-test-first refactor slice and a feature-first flag slice, each with its own record.

assertions.text: Each slice has exactly one posture.

forbidden_actions: Record feature-first for the whole mixed task.

pass: Two records appear, one per slice.
fail: The refactor inherits the weaker feature-first posture.
